mistag_cases.why: it carries the shape of printed output — a traceback, a log level, or a tool's error banner
mistag_cases.content:
LOGFILE="$HOME/code/homelab/main/viking/docs/ov-queue-monitor.log"
mkdir -p "$HOME/code/homelab/main/viking/docs"

OV=/usr/local/bin/ov   # or wherever ov lives in this PATH

prev_pending=0; prev_inprog=0; prev_processed=0; prev_errors=0
tick=0

poll_and_emit() {
    tick=$((tick + 1))
    local ts
    ts=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')

       # Fetch JSON and aggregate in one Python call — outputs "P\tI\tPR\tE" TSV
    local snapshot
    snapshot=$("$OV" status -o json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except:
    sys.exit(1)
total_p = total_i = total_pr = total_e = 0
tbl = data.get('result',{}).get('components',{}).get('queue',{}).get('status','')
for line in tbl.splitlines():
    cells = [c.strip() for c in re.split(r'\|+', line.strip()) if c.strip()]
    if len(cells) < 7: continue
    try:
        name, p = cells[0], int(cells[1])
        i, pr, e = int(cells[2]), int(cells[3]), int(cells[5])
        if name == 'TOTAL':
            total_p, total_i, total_pr, total_e = p, i, pr, e
    except ValueError:
        pass
print(f'{total_p}\t{total_i}\t{total_pr}\t{total_e}')
" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ -z "$snapshot" ]; then
        echo "[$ts] ERROR: ov status returned no queue data (tick=$tick)" >> "$LOGFILE"
        return
    fi

       # Parse the single aggregated TSV line
    local pending inprog processed errors
    IFS=$'\t' read -r pending inprog processed errors <<< "$snapshot"
    pending=${pending:-0}; inprog=${inprog:-0}; processed=${processed:-0}; errors=${errors:-0}

       # Compute deltas
    local d_pending=$((pending - prev_pending))
    local d_processed=0; [[ $tick -gt 1 ]] && d_processed=$((processed - prev_processed))
    local signal=""

       # Errors (any tick)
    if [ "$errors" -gt 0 ]; then
        signal="⚠ ERRORS=${errors} pending=${pending} inprog=${inprog} processed=${processed}"
    fi

       # Drain to zero
    if [ "$pending" -eq 0 ] && [ "$inprog" -eq 0 ]; then
        signal="🏁 DRAIN: pending=0 inprog=${inprog} processed=${processed}"
    fi

       # Progress (tick > 1 only)
    if [ -z "$signal" ] && [ $tick -gt 1 ]; then
        if [ "$d_processed" -ge 20 ]; then
            signal="📈 +${d_processed} processed pending=${pending} inprog=${inprog} total=${processed}"
        elif [ "$d_pending" -lt -10 ]; then
            local drop=$(( -d_pending ))
            signal="📉 pending -${drop} (was ${prev_pending}→${pending}) inprog=${inprog} total=${processed}"
        fi
    fi

       # Regression (any tick)
    if [ "$d_pending" -ge 50 ] && [ -z "$signal" ]; then
        signal="📊 pending +${d_pending} (regression: ${prev_pending}→${pending}) processed=${processed}"
    fi

       # First baseline always emits
      [ $tick -eq 1 ] && signal="🆕 BASELINE: pending=${pending} inprog=${inprog} processed=${processed}"

       # Emit to log + stdout
    if [ -n "$signal" ]; then
        echo "[$ts] TICK=${tick} ${signal}" >> "$LOGFILE"
        echo "$signal"
    fi

    prev_pending=$pending; prev_inprog=$inprog; prev_processed=$processed; prev_errors=$errors
}

echo "=== OV Queue Monitor started $(date) ===" >> "$LOGFILE"
poll_and_emit   # first tick fires immediately

while true; do
    sleep 180     # 3 min — off :00/:30 stampede, fast enough to catch a drain
    poll_and_emit
done
